package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/hex"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"testing"

	"github.com/waiting-here/NonbiriAPI/internal/auth"
	"github.com/waiting-here/NonbiriAPI/internal/db"
	"github.com/waiting-here/NonbiriAPI/internal/ledger"
)

// Compiled only against the pinned released source, using its public game APIs.
func TestWriteReleasedProgressionFixture(t *testing.T) {
	if db.GenerationTwoSchemaHash() != "dcce93b162d6f9540ec45118fbcc9661b633119fe35037213506a8f956117098" {
		t.Fatal("wrong source schema")
	}
	t.Run("duel", func(t *testing.T) {
		f := newDuelWireFixture(t)
		prior := f.matched("likes", "quick")
		r := f.call(0, "POST", "/api/games/likes/sessions/"+prior.ID+"/surrender", map[string]string{"phase_seq": prior.PhaseSeq}, false)
		if r.Code != 200 {
			t.Fatal("surrender", r.Code)
		}
		f.matched("bidding", "tier1")
		f.settlement()
		f.checkLedger()
		writeReleasedFixture(t, f.app, f.store, os.Getenv("NONBIRI_DUAL_DUEL_FIXTURE"))
	})
	t.Run("blackjack", func(t *testing.T) {
		f := newBlackjackHTTPFixture(t)
		joinBlackjackHTTP(f, 0)
		joinBlackjackHTTP(f, 1)
		ctx := context.Background()
		for i := 2; i < 10; i++ {
			z := db.EncodeU128(db.U128{})
			result, err := f.store.DB().Exec(`INSERT INTO users(discord_id,username,donation_credit_mag,total_requests,total_uncached_input_tokens,total_cache_write_input_tokens,total_cache_read_input_tokens,total_output_tokens,total_unknown_usage_requests,revision,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)`, fmt.Sprintf("released-seat-%d", i), "Synthetic player", z, z, z, z, z, z, z, z, f.now, f.now)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			id, err := result.LastInsertId()
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			f.users[1] = id
			raw := base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString(bytes.Repeat([]byte{byte(80 + i)}, 32))
			f.userCookies[1] = &http.Cookie{Name: auth.UserSessionCookieName, Value: raw}
			digest := sha256.Sum256([]byte(raw))
			f.bindings[1] = hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
			if _, err := f.store.DB().Exec(`INSERT INTO sessions(token_hash,user_id,last_seen_at,expires_at,absolute_expires_at,created_at,cred_gen) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?)`, f.bindings[1], id, f.now, f.now+3600, f.now+7200, f.now, "released-seat-session"); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			tx, err := f.store.DB().BeginTx(ctx, nil)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			general, err := ledger.CreateUserAssetAccount(ctx, tx, id, ledger.General, f.now)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if _, err := ledger.CreateUserAssetAccount(ctx, tx, id, ledger.Game, f.now); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			external, err := ledger.CodedAccount(ctx, tx, "external")
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			op, err := db.GenerateOpaqueID("op_")
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			plan, err := ledger.NewAdminUserAdjustment(ledger.Meta{OperationID: op, ActorUserID: f.adminID, CreatedAt: f.now}, general.ID, external.ID, ledger.AmountFromMilli(10000000), 0, ledger.Amount{}, "synthetic table funding")
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if _, err := ledger.Apply(ctx, tx, plan); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			joinBlackjackHTTP(f, 1)
		}
		var seated, waiting int
		if err := f.store.DB().QueryRow(`SELECT count(*) FROM game_blackjack_entries WHERE state='seated'`).Scan(&seated); err != nil || seated != 9 {
			t.Fatal("nine-seat fixture", seated, err)
		}
		if err := f.store.DB().QueryRow(`SELECT count(*) FROM game_blackjack_entries WHERE state='waiting'`).Scan(&waiting); err != nil || waiting != 1 {
			t.Fatal("waiter fixture", waiting, err)
		}
		f.checkLedger()
		writeReleasedFixture(t, f.app, f.store, os.Getenv("NONBIRI_DUAL_BLACKJACK_FIXTURE"))
	})
}
